svg.title: Trust telemetry as Prometheus, CEF and LEEF
svg.desc: One trust result in three export formats, from real runs of engine v0.38.0 (`kshana trust-telemetry`) on examples/maritime-trust: Prometheus text exposition (the latest trust score is 5.9 and the untrusted band is the one set), and the last CEF and LEEF messages. The command publishes nothing unless given a destination, holds no credentials, and transmits no radio signal. Advisory software, not type-approved navigation equipment (IEC 61108, IEC 61162): the operator remains responsible for the navigation of the vessel.
